title: Edmund and the Choir
author: Jonah Underhill
blurb: Elodie Dunmore, an exiled storm-caller, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
